title: The Effects of Light on Plant and Animal Species

sentences.en: Light is important to organisms for two different reasons.
sentences.zh: 光对生物很重要,原因有二

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Firstly it is used as a cue for the timing of daily and seasonal rhythms in both plant and animals, and secondly it is used to assist growth in plants.
sentences.zh: 首先,它被用来作为动植物每日和季节性节奏的提示,其次,它被用来协助植物生长。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Breeding in most organisms occurs during a part of the year only, and so a reliable cue is needed to trigger breeding behaviour.
sentences.zh: 大多数生物体的育种仅发生在一年的某一部分,因此,需要可靠的提示才能触发繁殖行为。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 分词结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；分词短语压缩了背景或附加动作。

sentences.en: Day length is an excellent cue, because it provides a perfectly predictable pattern of change within the year.
sentences.zh: 日长是一个极好的提示,因为它提供了一年之内完全可以预测的变化模式。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

sentences.en: In the temperate zone in spring, temperatures fluctuate greatly from day to day, but day length increases steadily by a predictable amount.
sentences.zh: 在温带的春季,气温每天波动很大,但日间长度稳定增加,数量可以预测。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: The seasonal impact of day length on physiological responses is called photoperiodism, and the amount of experimental evidence for this phenomenon is considerable.
sentences.zh: 白天对生理反应的季节性影响被称为光时针,这一现象的实验证据数量相当多。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: For example, some species of birds’ breeding can be induced even in midwinter simply by increasing day length artificially (Wolfson 1964).
sentences.zh: 例如,即使在年中,甚至可以通过人工增加日长度来诱发鸟类繁殖的某些种类(沃夫森1964年)。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: Other examples of photoperiodism occur in plants.
sentences.zh: 植物中也出现光时尚现象。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: A short-day plant flowers when the day is less than a certain critical length.
sentences.zh: 当一天的花花长度低于某一临界长度时,花花是短日的花朵。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

sentences.en: A long-day plant flowers after a certain critical day length is exceeded.
sentences.zh: 超过某一关键日数的长日花朵。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: In both cases the critical day length differs from species to species.
sentences.zh: 在这两种情况下,关键日长度因物种而异。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Plant which flower after a period of vegetative growth, regardless of photoperiod, are known as day-neutral plants.
sentences.zh: 植物在植物生长一段时间后生长的花朵,无论光照期如何,都称为日中植物。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 被动语态
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: Breeding seasons in animals such as birds have evolved to occupy the part of the year in which offspring have the greatest chances of survival.
sentences.zh: 鸟类等动物的育种季节演变为后代存活机会最大的一年中的一部分。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 分词结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；分词短语压缩了背景或附加动作。

sentences.en: Before the breeding season begins, food reserves must be built up to support the energy cost of reproduction, and to provide for young birds both when they are in the nest and after fledging.
sentences.zh: 在繁殖季节开始之前,必须建立粮食储备,以支持繁殖的能源成本,并在幼鸟在巢中和在幼鸟出走后提供食物。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 状语从句
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

sentences.en: Thus many temperate-zone birds use the increasing day lengths in spring as a cue to begin the nesting cycle, because this is a point when adequate food resources will be assured.
sentences.zh: 因此,许多温带鸟类利用春季日长不断增长的一天作为开始筑巢周期的提示,因为这是确保充足粮食资源的关头。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 状语从句
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

sentences.en: The adaptive significance of photoperiodism in plant is also clear.
sentences.zh: 植物中光时尚主义的适应意义也很明显。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Short-day plant that flower in spring in the temperate zone are adapted to maximising seedling growth during the growing season.
sentences.zh: 温带春季花朵的短日植物在生长季节适应了最大限度地扩大育苗生长。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Long-day plants are adapted for situations that require fertilization by insects, or a long period of seed ripening.
sentences.zh: 长日植物适应需要昆虫施肥的情况,或长时期种子成熟。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: Short-day plant that flower in the autumn in the temperate zone are able to build up food reserves over the growing season and over winter as seeds.
sentences.zh: 秋天在温带的短日植物在温带开花,能够在生长季节和冬季作为种子积累粮食储备。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Day-neutral plant have an evolutionary advantage when the connection between the favourable period for reproduction and day length is much less certain.
sentences.zh: 当有利繁殖期与日长之间的联系远非确定性时,日中植物具有进化优势。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

sentences.en: For example, desert annuals germinate, flower and seed whenever suitable rainfall occurs, regardless of the day length.
sentences.zh: 例如,沙漠年产、花和种子,无论白天长短,只要有适当的降雨,就会产生适当的降雨。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: The breeding season of some plants can be delayed to extraordinary lengths.
sentences.zh: 一些植物的繁殖季节可被推迟至非常长的时间。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Bamboos are perennial grasses that remain in a vegetative state for many years and then suddenly flower, fruit and die (Evans 1976).
sentences.zh: 竹子是多年的植物植物,多年处于植物状态,然后突然花朵、水果和死亡(Evans,1976年)。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Every bamboo of the species Chusquea abietifolio on the island of Jamaica flowered, set seed and died during 1884.
sentences.zh: 牙买加岛上的每只Chusquea abietifolio物种的竹子都开花、种种种子,1884年死亡。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: The next generation of bamboo flowered and died between 1916 and 1918, which suggests a vegetative cycle of about 31 years.
sentences.zh: 下一代竹子在1916年至1918年间开花死亡, 这表明植物循环大约31年。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词。

sentences.en: The climatic trigger for this flowering cycle is not-yet known, but the adaptive significance is clear.
sentences.zh: 尚未知道这一开花周期的气候触发因素,但适应意义是显而易见的。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: The simultaneous production of masses of bamboo seeds (in some cases lying 12 to 15 centimetres deep on the ground) is more than all the seed-eating animals can cope with at the time, so that some seeds escape being eaten and grow up to form the next generation (Evans 1976).
sentences.zh: 同时生产竹籽(有时在地上深12至15厘米)比当时所有食种动物都更能应付,因此有些种子被吃掉,成长成下一代(Evans,1976年)。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: The second reason light is important to organisms is that it is essential for photosynthesis.
sentences.zh: 第二个原因是光对生物很重要,因为它对光合作用至关重要。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: This is the process by which plants use energy from the sun to convert carbon from soil or water into organic material for growth.
sentences.zh: 植物利用太阳的能源将土壤或水中的碳转化为有机材料,促进生长,正是通过这一过程。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: The rate of photosynthesis in a plant can be measured by calculating the rate of its uptake of carbon.
sentences.zh: 植物的光合作用率可以通过计算其吸收碳的速度来衡量。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: There is a wide range of photosynthetic responses of plants to variations in light intensity.
sentences.zh: 植物对光强度变化的光合反应范围广泛。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Some plants reach maximal photosynthesis at one-quarter full sunlight, and others, like sugarcane, never reach a maximum, but continue to increase photosynthesis rate as light intensity rises.
sentences.zh: 有些植物在四分之一的阳光下达到最大光合作用,而其他植物,如甘蔗,则从未达到最高水平,但随着光强度的上升,光合作用率继续上升。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Plants in general can be divided into two groups: shade-tolerant species and shade-intolerant species.
sentences.zh: 一般而言,植物可分为两类:遮荫耐受物种和遮荫耐受物种。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: This classification is commonly used in forestry and horticulture.
sentences.zh: 这种分类在林业和园艺中常用。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Shade-tolerant plant have lower photosynthetic rates and hence have lower growth rates than those of shade-intolerant species.
sentences.zh: 耐沙植物的光合率较低,因此增长率低于耐遮荫物种。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Plant species become adapted to living in a certain kind of habitat, and in the process evolve a series of characteristics that prevent them from occupying other habitats.
sentences.zh: 植物物种适应于某种生境,在这一过程中,形成一系列特征,阻止它们占据其他生境。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Grime (1966) suggests that light may be one of the major components directing these adaptations.
sentences.zh: Grime(1966年)建议,光可能是指导这些调整的主要组成部分之一。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: For example, eastern hemlock seedlings are shade-tolerant.
sentences.zh: 例如,东部的母头苗苗是容阴的。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: They can survive in the forest understorey under very low light levels because they have a low photosynthetic rate.
sentences.zh: 他们可以在极低光度下在森林下层生存,因为他们的光合率低。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

items.prompt: There is plenty of scientific evidence to support photoperiodism.
Some types of bird can be encouraged to breed out of season.
Photoperiodism is restricted to certain geographic areas.
Desert annuals are examples of long-day plants.
Bamboos flower several times during their life cycle.
Scientists have yet to determine the cue for Chusquea abietifolia’s seasonal rhythm.
Eastern hemlock is a fast-growing plant.
Day length is a useful cue for breeding in areas where …………………………………. are unpredictable.
Plants which do not respond to light levels are referred to as …………………………………..
Birds in temperate climates associate longer days with nesting and the availability of ………………………………….
Plants that Bower when days are long often depend on …………………………………. to help them reproduce.
Desert annuals respond to …………………………………. as a signal for reproduction.
There is no limit to the photosynthetic rate in plants such as …………………………………..
Tolerance to shade is one criterion for the …………………………………. of plants in forestry and horticulture.
